naive_variants.description: `principal in UserGroup` as a single parent edge (no transitive membership).
Cedar `action in [A,B,C]` translated as equality (ignores the action hierarchy).
`A || B` as plain disjunction; an erroring left operand should skip the policy.

`unless {isPrivate}` as `not (isPrivate = true)`, `!context.is_authenticated` as `not (is_authenticated = true)`, and no has-blocked guard on the owner: Cedar skips a policy whose condition errors on a missing attribute.
Conditions translated as plain Boolean logic; Cedar skips a policy whose condition errors (missing context.target, job, owner).
A RoleBinding treated as granting in every namespace.
Aggregation followed one level only (no transitive closure).
The "*" wildcard treated as a literal string.
`p in p.^parents` written with reflexive closure (always true).
`wife = ~husband` as the inclusion wife in ~husband only.
rootedAt as `root in node.*r` instead of `node in root.*r`.
StringNotEquals with the key absent treated as not matching (AWS: it matches).
BoolIfExists treated as Bool (missing key -> false).
